fermions.description: Standard fermionic oscillators a_1^± (single pair, CAR). No supplementary fermion a_0.

standard_fermion_anticommutators.description: Canonical anticommutation relations for standard fermionic pair

bosonic_commutators.description: Canonical commutation relations for bosonic oscillators

mixed_commutators.description: Commutation relations between different oscillator types

kappa.label: κ
kappa.description: Central element for the odd-odd anticommutator. Arises from normal-ordering constant -1/2 in the expansion of b_k^+b_k^- = sum_{t=k}^n H_t - 1/2. Stored as K in the bracket output.
kappa.note: In the implementation, κ is stored as generator 'K'.

K.label: K
K.description: Central element representing the constant term -1/2 from boson number operator expansion. Together with κ, spans the 2-dimensional center of C(n+1).
K.note: K is the constant term generator in bracket output.

basis.ordering_convention: PBW ordering (Option A): (1) Central element κ; (2) Odd generators: E_eps1_del{k}_pp, E_eps1_del{k}_pm, E_eps1_del{k}_mp, E_eps1_del{k}_mm (k=1..n); (3) Even generators: Cartan H_1..H_{n+1}, positive long E_2del{k}_p, positive short sum E_del{i}_del{j}_pp (i<j), negative long E_2del{k}_m, negative short sum E_del{i}_del{j}_mm (i<j), mixed E_del{i}_del{j}_pm (i<j), E_del{i}_del{j}_mp (i<j); (4) Central element K.

generator_realization.description: Standard form expressions with oscillator realizations. No supplementary fermion a_0. Odd generators are E_{ε₁±δ_k} = a_1^± b_k^±. No sqrt(2) factors in coefficients.

E_eps1_del1_pp.note: Odd root ε₁+δ_1. Frappat: E_{ε₁+δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^+.

E_eps1_del2_pp.note: Odd root ε₁+δ_2. Frappat: E_{ε₁+δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^+.

E_eps1_del3_pp.note: Odd root ε₁+δ_3. Frappat: E_{ε₁+δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^+.

E_eps1_del1_pm.note: Odd root ε₁-δ_1. Frappat: E_{ε₁-δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^-.

E_eps1_del2_pm.note: Odd root ε₁-δ_2. Frappat: E_{ε₁-δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^-.

E_eps1_del3_pm.note: Odd root ε₁-δ_3. Frappat: E_{ε₁-δ_k} = a_1^+ b_k^-.

E_eps1_del1_mp.note: Odd root -(ε₁-δ_1). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁-δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^+.

E_eps1_del2_mp.note: Odd root -(ε₁-δ_2). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁-δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^+.

E_eps1_del3_mp.note: Odd root -(ε₁-δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁-δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^+.

E_eps1_del1_mm.note: Odd root -(ε₁+δ_1). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁+δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^-.

E_eps1_del2_mm.note: Odd root -(ε₁+δ_2). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁+δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^-.

E_eps1_del3_mm.note: Odd root -(ε₁+δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(ε₁+δ_k)} = a_1^- b_k^-.

H_1.note: Bosonic Cartan H_1 = b_1^+ b_1^- - b_2^+ b_2^-.

H_2.note: Bosonic Cartan H_2 = b_2^+ b_2^- - b_3^+ b_3^-.

H_3.note: Terminal bosonic Cartan H_3 = b_3^+ b_3^- + 1/2.

H_{n+1}.note: Fermionic Cartan generator H_{n+1} = a_1^+ a_1^- - 1/2.

E_del1_del2_pp.note: Short even root +δ_1+δ_2. Frappat: E_{δ_i+δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^+.

E_del1_del3_pp.note: Short even root +δ_1+δ_3. Frappat: E_{δ_i+δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^+.

E_del2_del3_pp.note: Short even root +δ_2+δ_3. Frappat: E_{δ_i+δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^+.

E_del1_del2_mm.note: Short even root -(δ_1+δ_2). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i+δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^-.

E_del1_del3_mm.note: Short even root -(δ_1+δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i+δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^-.

E_del2_del3_mm.note: Short even root -(δ_2+δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i+δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^-.

E_del1_del2_pm.note: Mixed even root δ_1-δ_2. Frappat: E_{δ_i-δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^-.

E_del1_del2_mp.note: Mixed even root -(δ_1-δ_2). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i-δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^+.

E_del1_del3_pm.note: Mixed even root δ_1-δ_3. Frappat: E_{δ_i-δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^-.

E_del1_del3_mp.note: Mixed even root -(δ_1-δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i-δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^+.

E_del2_del3_pm.note: Mixed even root δ_2-δ_3. Frappat: E_{δ_i-δ_j} = b_i^+ b_j^-.

E_del2_del3_mp.note: Mixed even root -(δ_2-δ_3). Frappat: E_{-(δ_i-δ_j)} = b_i^- b_j^+.

K.note: Central element K. Arises from normal-ordering constant -1/2 in b_k^+b_k^- expansion.

structure_constants.description: Non-zero brackets [X, Y] = sum_Z c_Z Z. For odd-odd pairs: anticommutator {X,Y}. Otherwise: commutator [X,Y]. Coefficients are exact rational numbers (no sqrt(2)). Computed via direct Frappat formula (C_generators.py).

metadata.reference: Frappat et al., Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras (2000), p.219-220. C(n+1) = osp(2|2n) oscillator realization.
metadata.computation_method: Direct Frappat formula with exact rational arithmetic (Python Fraction). Sections: Cartan×odd, odd-odd, Cartan×even, even×even, even×odd, short×short.

basis_convention.description: Standard Frappat basis with even roots from sp(2n) only (no ε-even roots). PBW: κ < odd < even < K.
